title: E5 Task 5: Orchestrator turn loop
description: The integrating per-turn loop (E5 acceptance #1,#4). Assemble context, call the model, parse + execute tool calls deterministically, feed results back, capture final narration, append scene_log, recordTurnTrace, and write scene_summary on a scene-close boundary. Turn is atomic: tool errors return structured errors to the model; model/SDK failure leaves pre-turn state intact. Prose that is not a tool call never mutates canon. Fills the Orchestrator seam.
acceptance_criteria: a full player turn runs end to end; model prose (no tool call) does not mutate canon; tool error returns structured error to model; model failure leaves pre-turn state intact; build + test pass.
close_reason: Orchestrator turn loop implemented and verified (re-close after parallel-agent state drift)

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: TDD: RED — test/orchestrator.test.ts 9/9 failing.
